title: Intimidate
wikitext:
{{status
| name                   = Intimidated
| type                   = Debuff
| description            = You are Intimidated, increasing Attack Damage taken.
}}
'''Intimidated''' is a [[debuff]] that causes the affected target to take 10% increased attack damage.

__TOC__
==Mechanics==
Intimidate does not increase [[damage over time]] taken, even if the damage is from an [[attack]] which applies attack damage modifiers to its damage over time effect.

==Modifiers==
{{modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where=
  (mod_stats.id LIKE "%intimidate%" OR mods.stat_text LIKE "%intimidate%" ) 
AND mods.generation_type NOT IN (10, 24, 28, 29) 
AND mods.domain NOT IN ("16", "38")
AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%elder%" AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%shaper%" AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%basilisk%" AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%crusader%" AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%adjudicator%" AND mod_spawn_weights.tag NOT LIKE "%eyrie%" 
AND mods.tags HOLDS NOT "necropolis_exclusive_mod"
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|generation_type=1
|domain=1
}}
===Eldritch implicit===
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where= ( mod_stats.id LIKE "%intimidate%" OR mods.stat_text LIKE "%intimidate%" ) AND mods.generation_type IN (28, 29)
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
}}

===Influenced mod===
These influence explicit mods are either drops from Shaper or Elder or the [[Conquerors]] (Elderslayers) (Read the spawn weight and mod name for details). Alternatively, [[harvest crafting]] or using an [[Influenced Exalted Orb]].
{{modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where=
  (mod_stats.id LIKE "%intimidate%" OR mods.stat_text LIKE "%intimidate%" ) AND mod_spawn_weights.value > 0 AND mods.generation_type NOT IN (10, 24, 28, 29) AND (mod_spawn_weights.tag LIKE "%elder%" OR mod_spawn_weights.tag LIKE "%shaper%" OR mod_spawn_weights.tag LIKE "%basilisk%" OR mod_spawn_weights.tag LIKE "%crusader%" OR mod_spawn_weights.tag LIKE "%adjudicator%" OR mod_spawn_weights.tag LIKE "%eyrie%" )
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|generation_type=1
}}

===Synthesised implicit mods===
Synthesis implicit can only be found on [[Synthesised_item#Unique_Synthesised_items|Synthesis unique]] in all leagues, or existing non-unique items in the permanent leagues.
{{Modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID
|q_where=
  (mod_stats.id LIKE "%intimidate%" OR mods.stat_text LIKE "%intimidate%" ) AND mods.id LIKE "%Synthesis%" AND mods.generation_type = "3"
|stat_text=1
|level=1
}}

==Legacy mods==
* '''Enchantments'''
[[Divine Font]] in the Labyrinths, no longer offer these enchantments. The mod can only be found in the existing items in the permanent leagues
{{modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID
|q_where=   ( mod_stats.id LIKE "%intimidate%" OR mods.stat_text LIKE "%intimidate%" ) AND mods.generation_type = 10
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|labyrinth=1
}}

* '''Fossil-only mods'''
Fossil only mod are not craftable anymore since [[version 3.10.0]]:
{{modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats, spawn_weights
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where=
  (mod_stats.id LIKE "%intimidate%" OR mods.stat_text LIKE "%intimidate%" ) AND mods.domain = 16
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|generation_type=1
}}
* '''Necropolis mods'''
League mechanic of [[necropolis league]] is not added to the game, so that these those can only found in the permanent leagues:
{{modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID
|q_where=
  (mod_stats.id LIKE "%intimidate%" OR mods.stat_text LIKE "%intimidate%" ) AND mods.tags HOLDS "necropolis_exclusive_mod"
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|generation_type=1
|domain=1
}}

* '''Scourge '''
Scourge mods are currently unable to obtain in temporary leagues. It can only be found on existing items in the permanent leagues, that are originally drop or created during [[Scourge league]]
{{modifier table
|q_tables=mod_stats, spawn_weights
|q_join=mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=spawn_weights._pageID
|q_where=
  (mod_stats.id LIKE "%intimidate%" OR mods.stat_text LIKE "%intimidate%" ) AND mods.generation_type =24
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|generation_type=1
}}
